runtime.caveat: The local runtime is below the declared engine floor and is not the pinned npm CLI. The supported-version matrix is configured for remote CI but has not been executed in this container.

reactDomainAndSourceAccessibilityTests.detail: Domain/data tests and source assertions only; not browser accessibility evidence.

offlineStructuralTypecheck.detail: Not the official TypeScript 7 project typecheck.
